verdict.rationale: AIMA is a government immigration agency service that handles personal data, so whether users can keep their data out of AI training is a fair privacy-posture question. The only evidence is a failed TLS probe of robots.txt, which says nothing about AI-training policy or opt-out controls. Lack of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
